Priya: Heads-up: planning RC cut for redwood-inference v2.3.0-rc5 at 03:00 UTC. Short window, want fast smoke then slow canary. Can infra/sec/qa ack? @Jorge @Nina
Jorge: Ack. I'll run the pre-cut smoke at 02:40 and paste the failing traces if any.
Nina: Security quickpass scheduled. Also will verify KMS key rotation hasn't broken auth.
deploybot: deploybot: artifact uploaded: redwood-inference:v2.3.0-rc5 (sha:def456). pin=candidate-rc5. Canary job enqueued.
Priya: Canary plan: 1% -> 10% (10m) -> 40% (15m) -> 100% if stable. Abort conditions: error_rate > 2% OR latency_p95 increase > 30% vs baseline.
Jorge: Smoke assertions: `p50 < 220ms`, `p95 < 420ms`, `rate_limit_errors == 0`. Kicking off smoke at 02:40.
Oncall: I'll monitor SLO dashboards and pager hooks. If we need immediate rollback use the k8s command below (I've also primed the pipeline to allow one-click revert).
Oncall: ```
# k8s rollback to stable replica set
kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-inference -n prod --to-revision=5
# or run the automated rollback job
ci run rollback/redwood-inference --to=v2.2.10 --reason="rc5-stream-regression"
```
QA: Running integration matrix now (streams, batch embeddings, rerank). ETA 10m.
Jorge: Local smoke: passing. Sample trace: https://internal/traces/def456. No alloc spikes.
deploybot: deploybot: canary 1% promoted -> 10%. telemetry: p50=195ms, p95=360ms, error_rate=0.3%.
Nina: Sec scan green for secrets, KMS checks passed. Minor IAM lint noted, non-blocking.
QA: At 10% we see a reproducible regression in streaming (connection reset on long streams ~5% of runs). Marking as hold.
Priya: Holding promotion at 10%. Do not advance. Jorge, can you reproduce locally? If it's intermittent maybe we can forward-fix config and re-run smoke.
Jorge: Reproduced with long-stream test. Logs show upstream proxy resetting idle connections at ~30s. Suspect a timeout mismatch introduced in rc5.
Oncall: Given this, we should not promote to 40%. Options: back out rc5 to stable or hotfix and re-cut rc6. What's the team's preference?
Priya: Let's abort this promo and rollback to last stable v2.2.10. We need a hotfix branch to address proxy timeout before re-cut.
QA: Agree. We'll re-run the streaming suite after hotfix.
deploybot: deploybot: canary promotion aborted by Priya. Initiating rollback to v2.2.10.
deploybot: deploybot: rollback complete. prod now pinned to v2.2.10. release-notes: https://internal/release/2.2.10
Priya: Thanks everyone. Action items: (1) Jorge to open hotfix branch and PR for proxy-timeout (tag: rc5-hotfix), (2) Nina to verify no IAM regressions in hotfix, (3) QA to re-run streaming tests on rc6.
Jorge: Creating PR now: https://internal/pr/6789. I'll include a small integration test for long streams.
Nina: Will re-run sec quickpass after PR merge.
QA: We'll standby for rc6 smoke. Keep this thread for rollback audit and links. :memo:
